title: Sapphire Ice and Leisure opened in Romford
summary: Havering Council's 2017/18 performance reporting recorded Sapphire Ice and Leisure, the new Romford leisure centre, as opening on 3 February 2018.
observed_change: A new public leisure centre with ice, swimming, fitness, and community-facing facilities entered documented public use in Romford.
source_name: London Borough of Havering Cabinet public pack: Corporate Performance Report 2017/18
source_date_field: Cabinet performance report states Sapphire Ice and Leisure opened on 3 February 2018
architect: Willmott Dixon, SLM / Everyone Active, London Borough of Havering, and Sapphire Ice and Leisure project team; architect not named in the cited council performance extract
project_type: public leisure centre and ice rink
geometry_source: Approximate point placed at Sapphire Ice and Leisure on Western Road, Romford.
limitations: The source records public opening and early attendance only. It does not provide a measured building footprint, detailed procurement record, final cost audit, operator contract terms, or later leisure-use data.
duplicate_check_note: Searched the manual architecture milestones file and tmp London candidate files for Sapphire Ice, Sapphire Ice and Leisure, Romford Leisure Centre, proposed event_id, source URL, and source_record_id variants; only Streatham Ice and Leisure was found, with no matching Sapphire record.
source_audit_note: Official Havering Council cabinet/performance material gives a day-level opening date and identifies the facility as the new Romford Leisure Centre; a separate Havering news page also corroborates the facility as recently opened in October 2018.

title: Acton Town Hall reopened as the Everyone Active Acton Centre
summary: Around Ealing recorded that Acton Town Hall was comprehensively redeveloped and reopened as the Everyone Active Acton Centre in April 2014, with Acton Library moved into the new centre.
observed_change: A former civic building re-entered public use as a combined leisure, library, and community facility in Acton.
source_date_field: Council magazine article states Acton Town Hall reopened as Everyone Active Acton Centre in April 2014
architect: S&P Architects, Ealing Council, Everyone Active, Carillion, and Acton Centre project team
project_type: listed civic-building redevelopment into leisure centre, library, and community rooms
geometry_source: Approximate point placed at Acton Centre / Acton Town Hall, High Street, W3 6NE.
limitations: The source gives month-level reopening evidence. It does not provide the exact first public opening day for each component, measured internal boundaries, detailed conservation scope, or later residential conversion activity elsewhere in the town-hall complex.
duplicate_check_note: Searched the manual architecture milestones file and tmp London candidate files for Acton Centre, Everyone Active Acton, Acton Town Hall Library, Old Acton Town Hall, proposed event_id, source URL, and source_record_id variants; no existing matching milestone was found.
source_audit_note: Council-linked Around Ealing evidence gives the reopening month and facility change. A separate Ealing Council community-right-to-bid notice corroborates that new Acton library facilities opened as part of the Old Acton Town Hall redevelopment in April 2014.

geometry_source: Approximate point placed at Harrow Lodge Leisure Centre in Harrow Lodge Park.
limitations: The event records the first phased opening date under Covid restrictions. The majority of facilities opened after 17 May 2021, and the source does not provide a measured footprint, final account, or later operating data.

title: Rainham Leisure Centre opened
summary: Havering Council's 2023/24 capital outturn report recorded the new Rainham Leisure Centre as completed and opened on 1 July 2023.
observed_change: A new public leisure centre entered documented public use at Rainham Recreation Ground.
source_name: London Borough of Havering Cabinet report: Council Revenue and Capital Outturn 2023/24
source_date_field: Capital outturn report states the new Rainham Leisure Centre was completed and opened on 1 July 2023
architect: ReCreation, Everyone Active, London Borough of Havering, and Rainham Leisure Centre project team; architect not named in the cited council outturn report
geometry_source: Approximate point placed at Rainham Leisure Centre / Rainham Recreation Ground.
limitations: The source records completion and opening date at capital-outturn level. Havering's earlier opening notice indicates dry-side facilities opened first, with wet facilities following later in summer 2023; the event therefore records the initial public opening, not full commissioning of every facility.
